name: Kettlebell Double Clean
steps: Set two bells just ahead of your feet in a wide stance.
Hinge at the hips and grasp both handles with a firm grip.
Hike both kettlebells back high between your thighs, then snap your hips and knees explosively straight to drive the bells upward close to your body.
Guide your elbows close and slide your hands through the handles to receive the bells softly against your forearms.
Swing the bells back down between your legs into the hip hinge to begin the next repetition or park them safely on the floor.
tips: Keep the kettlebells close to your torso and rotate your hands around the handles so the bells do not bang against your forearms.
Generate power from a crisp hip snap rather than pulling the bells straight up with your arms.
